definitions.initialProjection: Physical bodies, ratings/profiles, actual snap delays/cadences, installed targets/drive/pull rules/roles, calls and seeds are matched. Only obsolete combination.nextRead/secureSince caches may be omitted from the equality projection, explicitly reported by each row. No player body or football assignment is normalized.
definitions.actualClimbs: Count every block_climb in complete native result.events. The old collector wraps only commands: candidate prepass events are missing from earnedClimbs and old per-update ownership/cue records. Command-local continuity is labelled partial, never proof of every prepass transfer.
definitions.personalRead: A genuine combo.reads[installed member].readAt transition denotes a scheduled attention attempt, not necessarily a visual read: physical inadmissibility may short-circuit sim.see. Actual own keeper/DL and backer/RB pictures are counted separately by observer and phase. Before absent is unavailable; it is not filled from a partner/shared clock.
definitions.cadence: Successive actual personal readAt changes are compared against that same observer’s previously recorded nextRead. One reader never supplies another member’s clock.
definitions.nativeRelease: The actual block_climb event actor is the departing player. Personal proposal/current tick/own cue images and real keeper hand object are recorded at event emission before following commands and the native solve.
definitions.historicalRemoteDeparture: For B only, actual RunBlocker command observer differs from emitted climber. Climber pictures are captured only if really consumed during that decision; historical personal state is unavailable.
definitions.keeperContinuity: Six fixed common-tap witnesses retain the exact per-play native keeper joint ID/state at decision and following solve, actual member support/leverage, and completed loads for OL or TE. Command-local panel continuity omits prepass decisions.
definitions.laterContact: Witness backer follow-up requires positive real hand normal/tangent load or body impulse after the release. Panel firstHands/firstContacts are genuine OL first-pair observations only; missing TE metrics or earlier first contact is explicit, not a proven whiff.
definitions.nativeLimits: OL budget excess is evaluated only at old retained controller rows; global work/momentum and support-motor residuals cover every real solved tick. No runtime-speed conclusion is drawn from diagnostics.
definitions.units: Distances yd, times s, forces kg·yd/s², impulses kg·yd/s, work kg·yd²/s²; multiply by .9144 or .9144² for SI.

limitations: Six fixed mechanism witnesses and one balanced160 generated roster panel are not NFL concept distributions or a population effect estimate. Supplemental two remain separate.

The unchanged162 collector does not capture candidate prepass personal states/cues or event-boundary hands. Detailed candidate continuity/self-read claims are limited to the six common-tap witnesses and independently controlled tests.
Historical B has no personal joined schedule or prepass; no corresponding historical state is invented. Its real shared-bookkeeping transitions and consumed observer pictures remain separate.
Same keeper hand through a release proves mechanical continuity, not that the eventual climb successfully blocks the backer or improves rushing. All negative differences remain in the report.
No new sim.see calls, simulated whistles, parked bodies, strength bonuses or global solver-resolution changes are introduced.

posthocAdverseInspection.selection: POST-HOC causal inspection after final C162 revealed adverse cases; excluded from ordinary160 and fixed-six mechanism population.

cohort.selection: POST-HOC adverse cases selected after C162 completed: ordinary OZ Odd L S3, Power Under L S11, Split Bear R S11, supplemental roster41/42 OZ Over L S11. These are causal inspection cases and are excluded from the fixed-six and balanced160 populations.

definitions.bodyDivergence: Each native20Hz tick hashes all physical Body objects before/after the original tick, without player tags. The first differing completed hash is the earliest actual saved physical divergence; it does not attribute all later yardage to one action.
definitions.intentDivergence: Hash actual delivered native intents after the completed tick. Assignment hashes use all offensive public RunBlocker plans, omitting personal/shared mental caches and tags.
definitions.controlledReuse: Identical common instrumentation pin with explicitly declared fixture/provenance substitution and added read-only hashes; all four observed/plain final-state/RNG controls and exact cached-panel public results must match.
definitions.population: Four selected losses are a separate explanatory inspection. Their reads, climbs and outcomes are never added to fixed-six or160 totals.
